user_saw: Selecting Fish Audio’s released `drama-3` model produced an “invalid Fish Audio model” error before synthesis.
summary: The fix adds `drama-3` to the Fish Audio model allowlist and updates the documentation to use the released ID.
reasoning: The preview commit added `drama-3-preview` to the allowlist, and the fix’s parent still rejected any ID absent from that list. The PR dates Fish Audio’s release of the `drama-3` ID to the following day, so the external release exposed the stale allowlist.
